detail: V69 and V79 official historical engines match the common execution model with KRW 0 final NAV error.
Independent V69/V79 cash, holdings, fills and session ledgers are stored transactionally and idempotently.
Canonical adjusted-OHLC long table, source tag, uniqueness and per-file SHA-256 manifest are generated.
V69 leader weight conflict removed; runtime registry contains exactly V69 champion and V79 challenger.
Ten-stage idempotent workflow, hourly scheduler, run manifests and fail-closed stage state are implemented.
Kill switch, concentration, open gap, daily loss, rolling drawdown, price and ADV gates are implemented.
SQLite online backup, SHA-256 and restore integrity/account/session checks pass.
Observed first/last bar availability proxy exists; complete delisted/liquidated ETF and historical taxonomy data remain unavailable.
Adjusted OHLC source is enforced, but distributions, splits and mergers are not independently reconciled to an event ledger.
A 60-120 session frozen dual-Paper period on newly arriving data is still required.
Existing V72 dashboard is single-account; V85 produces reports/DB but no dedicated dual-account UI.
The orchestrator uses the canonical data index; an independently verified KRX holiday/session feed is not yet integrated.
Daily adjusted OHLC and ADV impact are modeled; real order book, halts, price limits and intraday slicing remain unverified.
Docker/Compose definitions were updated, but no Docker or Podman executable was available in the audit environment.
